Name: Rohit Arora
Bio:
Rohit Arora is a Founder of Plaksha University. Rohit Arora has been an entrepreneur and investor for over three decades. He is currently the Founder and Chairman of Silverskills Pvt. Ltd. Silverskills and its associate companies provide business process management solutions to companies in the financial services and healthcare sectors globally. Prior to that Rohit had a joint venture with AIA Capital, a member company of American International Group (AIG). AIA Capital India Pvt. Ltd. provided investment banking and corporate finance services to both Indian and multinational corporations. Mr Arora was the Managing Director and Country Head for this company.

Rohit has been an early stage investor in several companies and serves on the Board of listed and unlisted companies as an independent director. Rohit started his career as a management consultant with A.F. Ferguson and Co., the then correspondents of KPMG in India. During this period, he worked on projects for the World Bank, the Indian armed forces, multinational corporations and large Indian public sector corporations. Rohit is a Fellow member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and holds a B.Com (Honors) from Delhi University.
Education: CA, ICAI | BCom Honours, University of Delhi
